findings.checklist_item: Add a short prior-art note comparing the windowed distinct-ratio discriminator (and its 0.50/24 constants) against established external agent loop-detection heuristics (n-gram/k-cycle detection, repeat-N-without-state-change), stating why the ratio form is chosen and how the threshold generalizes beyond the four in-house traces.
evidence: Plan fits the trip condition from four runs: 'distinct(last 24 tool calls) <= 0.50 fires on all three pathological runs ... and never on the healthy one — a ~5x margin'
Prior art considered is entirely in-repo (max_consecutive_repeat, the shipped forced-landing primitive, bounded recovery + finalizer)

Retrieved external prior art shows this is a well-trodden pattern: AgentBrake circuit breaker checks 'are you calling the same tool with the same arguments over and over' (dev.to/bossmetallique); agentic-harness guidance recommends 'loop detection that halts when the same tool call repeats more than three times without state change' (genalphai.com)
ABSENCE: no plan text surveys standard cycle-detection heuristics or argues why the distinct-ratio form is preferable to them beyond the four-trace fit
findings.finding: The chosen loop-detection discriminator (windowed distinct-ratio <= 0.50 over a trailing 24-call window) is justified only empirically against four in-house traces and against the in-repo `max_consecutive_repeat` metric; the plan does not consider established EXTERNAL loop-detection prior art (e.g. n-gram/k-cycle detection, 'same tool call with same args repeated N times without state change' as used in production agent harnesses/circuit breakers), leaving the threshold's generalizability beyond these four runs unexamined.
findings.location: Section 'The discriminator that works: a windowed distinct-ratio' and 'The shared discriminator contract'
scenarios: A future production run exhibits a loop shape (e.g. a long high-cardinality cycle, or interleaved productive+repeated calls) whose 24-window distinct-ratio stays above 0.50, so the guard silently misses it — untested because the threshold was fit to only four traces
A healthy large-epic run with legitimately low local novelty in a burst trips the threshold, reintroducing the capacity-cap the plan explicitly promises not to add
